profile.summary:
My name is Rafael Lopez, I began teaching myself how to code HTML, CSS, and JS in January 2022. I gravitated towards learning JavaScript as it’s been around for such a long time and the name was recognizable. I am proficient with JavaScript, React, Node.js, express.js, prisma, and more.
I hope to be developing a variety of creative websites and projects in the near future. During this journey, I also hope to inspire the new generation of kids in my family and show that there are other routes to take in life besides going straight to college.

projects.title: RevaTrust
projects.description:
Banking app where users can create an account, log in, and apply for a new bank account, credit line, loan, or savings account. Manager accounts can log in, view all pending applications, and approve or deny them. 
Utilizes a PostgreSQL database on a Java and Spring Boot server, unit testing with JUnit, and a React + TypeScript frontend. Hosted using AWS RDS and an AWS S3 bucket. Fully responsive with dark mode.

projects.title: InventGenie
projects.description: Capstone project for The Knowledge House. Inventory management system where users can login, manage, and track their inventory with a modern design and dark mode functionality. Took on a lead developer role alongside a dedicated UX/UI team.
